```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
Striper_clean <- read_excel("/Users/georgelepska/Desktop/Data Analysis Docs/STRIPED BASS DATA.xlsx")

install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("randomForest")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("car")
install.packages("caret")
install.packages("pROC")
install.packages("broom")
install.packages("glmnet")
install.packages("MASS")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(randomForest)
library(tidyr)
library(mgcv)
library(car)
library(glmnet)
library(caret)     
library(pROC)       
library(broom) 
library(MASS)

#New Variables:

Striper_clean$date <- ymd(Striper_clean$date)
Striper_clean$year <- year(Striper_clean$date)

#method_grouped
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    method_grouped = case_when(
      method == "casting" ~ "casting",           
      method == "trolling" ~ "trolling",         
      method %in% c("free line", "surfcasting", "bottom fishing", "jigging") ~ "other",  
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    # Reorder factor levels so "other" appears last
    method_grouped = factor(method_grouped, 
                           levels = c("casting", "trolling", "other"))
  )
#time_period
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    time_hour = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60
  )

Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    time_period = case_when(
    time_hour >= 5 & time_hour < 10 ~ "dawn",
    time_hour >= 10 & time_hour < 16 ~ "midday",
    time_hour >= 16 & time_hour < 21 ~ "dusk",
    time_hour >= 21 | time_hour < 5 ~ "night",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  time_period = factor(time_period)
)
#Season
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    neutral_date = as.Date(sprintf(
      "2000-%02d-%02d",
      month(date),
      day(date)
    ))
  )

Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    )
  )

Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    doy = yday(date)
  )
#Wind Speed
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    wind_direction = factor(
      wind_direction,
      levels = c("N", "NNE", "NE", "ENE", "E", "ESE", "SE", "SSE",
                 "S", "SSW", "SW", "WSW", "W", "WNW", "NW", "NNW")
    )
  )
#Wind Cardinal
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    wind_cardinal = if_else(
      is.na(wind_direction),
      NA_character_,
      substr(toupper(trimws(wind_direction)), 1, 1)
    )
  )
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    wind_cardinal = if_else(
      is.na(wind_direction),
      NA_character_,
      substr(toupper(trimws(wind_direction)), 1, 1)
    )
  )

Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    wind_cardinal = factor(
      wind_cardinal,
      levels = c("N", "E", "S", "W")
    )
  )

#Weather Grouped
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    weather_grouped = case_when(
      weather %in% c("rain", "light rain") ~ "rainy",           
      weather == "overcast" ~ "overcast",         
      weather %in% c("partly cloudy", "sunny") ~ "clear",  
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    weather_grouped = factor(weather_grouped)
  )
#Mood Phase Editing
Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    moon_phase = factor(
      moon_phase,
      levels = c("new moon", "waxing cresent", "first quarter", "waxing gibbous",
                 "full moon", "waning gibbous", "last quarter", "waning cresent")
    )
  )

Striper_clean <- Striper_clean %>%
  mutate(
    moon_numeric = as.numeric(moon_phase)
  )
```

# Graphs of weight and length by season
summary(Striper_clean$length)
# Calculate the 75th percentile
percentile_75 <- quantile(Striper_clean$length, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a new column to categorize values
Striper_clean$color_group <- ifelse(Striper_clean$length >= percentile_75, 
                                     "75th percentile+", "Below 75th percentile")

Striper_Histogram <- ggplot(Striper_clean, aes(x = length, fill = color_group)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Below 75th percentile" = "steelblue", 
                                "75th percentile+" = "orange"),
                    name = "Length Category") +
  labs(title = "Striper Length Distribution",
       x = "Length (in)", 
       y = "Count") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"  # You can change to "right", "bottom", "left", or c(x,y) for custom position
  )

print(Striper_Histogram)
ggsave("/Users/georgelepska/Desktop/Data Analysis Docs/striper_Histogram.png", 
       Striper_Histogram, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
Striper_Length_Barchart <- ggplot(Striper_clean %>% filter(!is.na(factor(year))), aes(x = factor(year), y = length)) +
   geom_boxplot(fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "#253494", alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "#e34a33") +
   xlab("Year") +

     plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
     axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
     panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
     plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
   )

print(Striper_Length_Barchart)

#Lures:
lure_2025_summary <- Striper_clean %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  count(method_grouped, season, lure_name, lure_length) %>%
  arrange(method_grouped, season, desc(n))
  
print(lure_2025_summary, n = Inf)

lure_2025_summary_noszn <- Striper_clean %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  count(lure_name, season) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
  
print(lure_2025_summary_noszn, n = Inf)

# First, find the top 5 lures by total frequency
top_5_lures <- Striper_clean %>%
  filter(year == 2025, !is.na(lure_name)) %>%  # Remove NA lures
  count(lure_name) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(lure_name)

print(top_5_lures)

lure_season_data <- Striper_clean %>%
  filter(year == 2025, lure_name %in% top_5_lures) %>%
  count(lure_name, season, method_grouped) %>%
  arrange(lure_name, season, method_grouped)

print(lure_season_data)

install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)  # For combining plots

#lures
library(patchwork)

# Plot 1: Just the tube (HORIZONTAL bars to match)
tube_plot <- lure_season_data %>%
  filter(lure_name == "Butchie Built Custom Tackle Red Tube") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(lure_name, n, sum), y = n, fill = season)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(0, max(x), by = 3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ method_grouped) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Winter" = "#C77CFF",
                                "Spring" = "#7CAE00", 
                                "Summer" = "#00BFC4",
                                "Fall" = "#F8766D")) +
  labs(title = "Red Tube: The Clear Winner",
       subtitle = "33 total uses",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Uses",
       fill = "Season") +  # Add this!
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

# Plot 2: The rest (already horizontal)
other_plot <- lure_season_data %>%
  filter(lure_name != "Butchie Built Custom Tackle Red Tube") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(lure_name, n, sum), y = n, fill = season)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ method_grouped, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(0, max(x), by = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Winter" = "#C77CFF",
                                "Spring" = "#7CAE00", 
                                "Summer" = "#00BFC4",
                                "Fall" = "#F8766D")) +
  labs(title = "Other Top Lures",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Uses",
       fill = "Season") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

# Combine side-by-side
combined_plot <- tube_plot / other_plot + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Top 5 Lures in 2025",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 21, hjust = 0.5)))

print(combined_plot)
ggsave(
  "/Users/georgelepska/Desktop/Data Analysis Docs/top5_lures_2025.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300
)

#new graph
library(patchwork)

# Softer colors
season_colors <- c(
  "Winter" = "#B19CD9",
  "Spring" = "#88B04B",
  "Summer" = "#5DADE2",
  "Fall" = "#E74C3C"
)

# Plot 1: tube plot with LARGER fonts
tube_plot <- lure_season_data %>%
  filter(lure_name == "Butchie Built Custom Tackle Red Tube") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = n, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ method_grouped) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = season_colors) +
  labs(title = "Red Tube: The Clear Winner",
       subtitle = "33 total uses",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Uses",
       fill = "Season") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +  # Changed from 11 to 14
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),  # Larger title
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),  # Larger subtitle
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),  # Larger facet labels
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray60"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20))  # Larger axis text

# Plot 2: other lures with LARGER fonts
other_plot <- lure_season_data %>%
  filter(lure_name != "Butchie Built Custom Tackle Red Tube") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(lure_name, n, sum), y = n, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ method_grouped, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(0, max(x), by = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = season_colors) +
  labs(title = "Other Top Lures",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Uses",
       fill = "Season") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +  # Changed from 11 to 14
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),  # Larger title
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),  # Larger facet labels
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray60"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),  # Larger axis text
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),  # Larger legend text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 2, face = "bold"))  # Larger legend title

# Combine
combined_plot <- tube_plot / other_plot + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2.5)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Top 5 Lures in 2025",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 27, hjust = 0.5))  # Larger main title
  )

print(combined_plot)

ggsave(

# Function to test a variable
test_variable <- function(base_model, new_formula, var_name, train_data) {
  new_model <- glm(new_formula, family = binomial, data = train_data)
  anova_result <- anova(base_model, new_model, test = "Chisq")
  p_value <- anova_result$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
  
  cat(var_name, ":\n")
  cat("  P-value:", round(p_value, 4))
  
  if(p_value < 0.05) {
    cat(" *** STRONG evidence - INCLUDE\n")
    return("Include")
  } else if(p_value < 0.10) {
    cat(" * Marginal evidence - CONSIDER\n")
    return("Consider")
  } else {
    cat(" - No evidence - EXCLUDE\n")
    return("Exclude")
  }
}

# Test each variable
results <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  Decision = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Test wind_speed_knots
decision <- test_variable(
  baseline_model,
  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + wind_speed_knots,
  "Wind Speed",
  train_data
)
p_val <- anova(
  baseline_model, 
  glm(success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + wind_speed_knots, 
      family = binomial, 
      data = train_data), 
  test = "Chisq"
)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
  Variable = "Wind Speed", 
  P_Value = p_val, 
  Decision = decision
))

library(pROC)

# Model 1: Simple (2 variables)
model_simple <- glm(
  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped,
  family = binomial,
  data = train_data
)

# Model 2: Simple + weather (3 variables)

  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + weather_grouped,
  family = binomial,
  data = train_data
)

# Model 3: Model 2 + time_period (4 variables)

  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + weather_grouped + time_period,
  family = binomial,
  data = train_data
)

# Model 4: Model 3 + wind_speed_knots (5 variables)
model_4 <- glm(
  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + weather_grouped + 
            time_period + wind_speed_knots,
  family = binomial,
  data = train_data
)

# Model 5: Model 4 + wind_cardinal (6 variables)
model_5 <- glm(
  success ~ water_temp + method_grouped + weather_grouped + 
            time_period + wind_speed_knots + wind_cardinal,
  family = binomial,
  data = train_data
)


# Calculate AUCs

  quiet = TRUE
))

  quiet = TRUE
))

  predict(model_3, test_data, type = "response"),
  quiet = TRUE
))

auc_4 <- auc(roc(

  predict(model_4, test_data, type = "response"),

))

auc_5 <- auc(roc(

))

# Create comparison table

  ),
  Variables = c(
    "water temp and method",
    "model1 and weather",
    "model2 and time of day",
    "model3 and wind speed",
    "model4 and wind direction"
  ),
  AUC = c(
    auc_1,

  ),

) %>%

coef_table <- tidy(model_2, conf.int = TRUE) %>%

  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(term, estimate, odds_ratio, odds_lower, odds_upper, p_value)

importance_df <- coef_table %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    abs_effect = abs(estimate),
    significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    term_clean = case_when(
      term == "water_temp" ~ "Water Temperature",
      term == "method_groupedtrolling" ~ "Trolling Method",
      term == "method_groupedother" ~ "Other Method",
      term == "weather_groupedovercast" ~ "Overcast Weather",
      term == "weather_groupedrainy" ~ "Rainy Weather",
      TRUE ~ gsub("_", " ", term)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_effect))

importance_plot <- ggplot(importance_df, 
                          aes(x = reorder(term_clean, abs_effect), 
                              y = abs_effect, 
                              fill = significant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#2E7D32",

  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjrt = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
